cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her left side; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries a camera by its grip at her side
